title: PepBank open data
description:
PepBank (https://pepbank.io) is a free peptide evidence database. This dataset holds its open records: peptides, publication metadata, clinical trials and study results. Each study result keeps the exact quote from its source. An AI model writes each result from the abstract, and software and a second AI model check it (method: https://pepbank.io/methods).

This version is at data version 310721. It covers 147 peptides, 6 blends and 13 other compounds, 97,577 study results from 17,383 studies, and 8,473 clinical trials. The files are JSONL, a SQLite database, a manifest and SHA-256 checksums.

The data is under CC BY 4.0. Values from ChEMBL are in a separate folder under CC BY-SA 3.0. Abstracts and quotes keep the license of their article. This is not medical advice.
